en.mw.mediaRecorder.waitingDescription: Recording will begin when the project starts.
en.mw.mediaRecorder.keepOpenDescription: Keep this window open or return to the editor while the capture runs.

en.mw.settingsModal.menuBarHint: Drag to reorder items within each group. Uncheck to hide.
en.mw.variableManager.defaultFilterHelp: Which category the Variable Manager shows when it opens.
en.mw.variableManager.liveUpdateHelp: Continuously refresh variable and list values while the project is running. Turning this off can improve performance for large projects.
en.mw.variableManager.updateThrottleHelp: Minimum time between live value refreshes. Higher values reduce CPU usage.
en.mw.variableManager.variableMaxLengthHelp: Variable values longer than this many characters are hidden behind a "too large to display" button to keep the editor responsive.
en.mw.variableManager.listMaxLengthHelp: List contents longer than this many characters are hidden behind a "too large to display" button to keep the editor responsive.
en.mw.debugger.stagePauseButton: Show Pause Button in Stage Controls
en.mw.debugger.stagePauseButtonHelp: Add a pause/play button between the green flag and stop buttons that can freeze the project. You can also use Alt+X (Option+X on macOS) to pause the project.
en.mw.debugger.stageStepButton: Show Frame Step Button When Paused
en.mw.debugger.stageStepButtonHelp: When the project is paused, add a button to advance exactly one frame so you can observe behavior changes step by step.
en.mw.debugger.threadGlowHelp: Draws a colored glow around the blocks that are currently being executed so you can follow which scripts are running.
en.mw.debugger.logClearGreenflagHelp: Empties the debugger log every time the green flag is clicked.
en.mw.debugger.logGreenflagHelp: Adds a debugger log entry each time the green flag is clicked.
en.mw.debugger.logCloneCreateHelp: Adds a debugger log entry each time a sprite creates a clone.
en.mw.debugger.logFailedCloneCreation: Log when the clone limit is exceeded
en.mw.debugger.logFailedCloneCreationHelp: Adds a debugger warning when a clone cannot be created because the 300 clone limit is reached.
en.mw.debugger.logBroadcastsHelp: Adds a debugger log entry each time a broadcast is received.
en.mw.debugger.fancyGraphsHelp: Smoothly animates the performance and memory graphs. Turning this off can improve performance on slower devices.
